metadata.description: Document knowledge ingestion with checkable provenance: source-backed units, tables and formulas as citable assets, adversarial audit, and a trace from any knowledge-base entry back to the exact text or table cell.

plugins.name: knowledge-ingestion
plugins.description: Seven-pass ingestion pipeline. Extracts molecular, source-backed knowledge units with verbatim citations; recovers tables, formulas and figures as typed assets that anchor to the text they sit in and travel with it; records fidelity so a transcription is never compared like a quote; audits every proposed entry adversarially before anything reaches a knowledge base.
